The '''MM7 rocket-powered flechette launcher''' was a single-shot [[wrist rocket launcher]] produced by [[Kelvarek Consolidated Arms/Legends|Kelvarek Consolidate Arms]]. It was used by the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]].
